subject: Conditional credit approval for Catalyst partner cohort
messages:
From: Tom Reynolds <tom@sproutlabs.ai>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: Elisabeth Greene <elisabeth@sproutlabs.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: extra cohort credit + short extension for Catalyst Cohort 8

Hi Avery,

Quick context — Sprout Labs is heading into Catalyst Cohort 8 next week. We had a delayed close on our seed round so our internal allocation for tooling credits ran a bit tight. We loved Redwood’s performance in the PoC and are excited to push a small pilot for the cohort demo day (Oct 28).

Two asks:
- Is there scope to top up the pilot credits by an additional $5k (trial credit) to cover burst usage across the demo week?
- If not full top-up, could we extend the trial period by 10 days to let us finish our usage patterns for the evaluation?

I attached a short note that shows our expected burst profile and the timelines (catalyst_cohort_request.pdf). We’re aiming to finalize procurement by next Tuesday; procurement@sproutlabs.ai is on copy.

Happy to jump on a 15-min call if easier.

Thanks —
Tom Reynolds
Head of Growth, Sprout Labs
Tom: 415-555-0142

Attachment: catalyst_cohort_request.pdf (PDF, 42KB)

From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom@sproutlabs.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: extra cohort credit + short extension for Catalyst Cohort 8

Hi Tom —

Thanks for the note and the attachment. Appreciate the clear timing. Short answer: we can do a conditional top-up but need to lock a few things on our side (success metrics + a short pilot agreement).

Proposal from Redwood (high level):
- Conditional $5k credit applied to your account, pending a signed pilot addendum and confirmation of demo workloads by Oct 25.
- If the pilot uses >80% of that credit before demo day, we can auto-approve an additional $2.5k one-time buffer.
- Extension: if you prefer not to take the top-up, we can extend the 30-day trial window by 10 days (no additional funds) — good for finishing evaluation but not for burst cost coverage.

Next steps I suggest:
1) Procurement signature on a 1-page pilot addendum (I’ll attach a draft).
2) Send us the expected peak request pattern (tokens/sec and max concurrent requests) — Marissa can help map that to cost.
3) If you confirm the top-up, we’ll provision the credit and send the invoice offset terms for accounting.

Looping in Marissa (pilot economics) and Karthik (partnership approvals) to move fast. If this works, I can have a signed addendum to you by EOD tomorrow.

Best,
Avery Johnson
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
avery_johnson@redwood.com | (650) 555-0198

Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom@sproutlabs.ai>, Elisabeth Greene <elisabeth@sproutlabs.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 08:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: extra cohort credit + short extension for Catalyst Cohort 8

Avery / Karthik —

I pulled a quick cost projection based on Tom’s burst numbers. Short summary: a $5k credit covers the forecasted spike through demo day with ~15% headroom; the risk profile is acceptable if we require the pilot addendum and that Sprout keeps any production traffic off the trial account.

I attached a draft one-page addendum (pilot_agreement_v2.pdf) that includes:
- Defined scope and success metrics (demo queries test set + 1 integration sprint)
- Credit redemption rules and expiry
- Clause for additional $2.5k buffer conditional on >80% consumption before Oct 27

If legal/signature is required, we’ll need procurement@sproutlabs.ai to countersign by Oct 25 for us to apply credits before Oct 26.

Recommend: approve conditional $5k with the addendum and ask for a simple acceptance email from their procurement team. I can shepherd the paperwork.

Marissa Cole
Partnerships, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachment: pilot_agreement_v2.pdf (PDF, 12KB)
